note: Salaries vary widely by city, company, and skills, so no figures are listed here. Check current postings on LinkedIn, Naukri, and company career pages for up-to-date ranges. Certifications are examples commonly seen in job posts, not requirements.

jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.summary: Monitors alerts in a Security Operations Centre, triages them, investigates suspicious activity, and escalates real incidents. A common first job in cybersecurity.
first: Finish TryHackMe SOC Level 1 or LetsDefend
Build a Wazuh/Elastic home lab and ingest your own logs
Write 3 investigation write-ups on GitHub or a blog

jobs.title: Penetration Tester
jobs.summary: Legally attacks systems, networks and applications with written permission to find weaknesses before criminals do, then reports findings and fixes.
first: Complete PortSwigger Academy apprentice & practitioner labs
Root 20+ retired HTB/TryHackMe machines with notes
Write a professional sample pentest report

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.summary: Secures workloads in AWS, Azure or GCP: identity and access, network controls, logging, posture management and secure infrastructure-as-code.
entry: AWS Cloud Practitioner → AWS Security Specialty
first: Use free tiers to build and harden a small app
Solve flAWS / flAWS2 challenges
Scan your Terraform with Checkov or tfsec and fix findings

jobs.title: GRC Analyst
jobs.summary: Governance, Risk & Compliance: writes policies, runs risk assessments and audits, and maps controls to standards like ISO 27001, NIST CSF, PCI DSS and India's DPDP Act, 2023.
first: Read ISO 27001 Annex A and NIST CSF 2.0 summaries
Write a sample security policy for a small business
Do a mock risk register for a fictional company

jobs.title: DFIR Analyst
jobs.summary: Digital Forensics & Incident Response: investigates breaches, collects and analyses evidence from disks, memory and logs, and helps organisations recover.
first: Practise with Blue Team Labs Online and CyberDefenders
Analyse a memory image with Volatility 3
Learn the NIST incident response lifecycle

jobs.title: Application Security (AppSec)
jobs.summary: Works with developers to build secure software: threat modelling, secure code review, security testing in CI/CD, and fixing vulnerabilities.
first: Build a small web app and break it yourself
Add Semgrep and dependency scanning to a GitHub Action
Complete OWASP Juice Shop challenges

jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.summary: Designs and runs secure networks: firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, IDS/IPS, NAC and monitoring of network traffic.
first: Build a lab with pfSense/OPNsense and VLANs
Use Cisco Packet Tracer for routing labs
Capture and explain traffic for 10 protocols in Wireshark
